scenes.text: This tutorial covers Model Compare. Run two Cellpose models on the same fields and compare masks, counts, and agreement metrics.
Open Model Compare from the Segmentation models section. Choose two candidate models and a representative set of microscopy fields.
In the main configuration area, match channels and preprocessing, then configure thresholds and the object-matching criteria.

Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. review side-by-side overlays together with object-count, overlap, and adjusted-Rand-index differences.
When the workflow finishes, the comparison report identifies where each model gains, loses, splits, or merges objects.
